questions.stemEn: A 10-year-old boy has urticaria on most days for 4 months. Individual wheals fade within hours. Which treatment is best for long-term control?
questions.explanationAr: الأعراض مستمرة أكثر من 6 أسابيع، لذلك هذا chronic urticaria. العلاج الأول طويل المدى هو second-generation non-sedating H1 antihistamine مثل fexofenadine. الستيرويد ليس علاج maintenance روتيني، والـfirst-generation antihistamines تسبب sedation أكثر.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Systemic steroids تُستخدم فقط في ظروف محددة وقصيرة، وليست خيارًا مزمنًا. Diphenhydramine وHydroxyzine أكثر تسببًا بالنعاس وتأثيرات anticholinergic.
questions.clinicalPearl: Chronic urticaria lasts >6 weeks and is treated first-line with a second-generation nonsedating H1 antihistamine.
managementSteps: Assess triggers only when clinically indicated

questions.stemEn: A child has seasonal allergic rhinitis. Which oral antihistamine option is preferred for ongoing symptom control?
questions.explanationAr: Loratadine وCetirizine كلاهما second-generation antihistamines ومفضلان على diphenhydramine بسبب قلة sedation. الاختيار بينهما يعتمد على العمر والتوافر؛ المصدر يذكر أن cetirizine معتمد لعمر أصغر من loratadine.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Diphenhydramine من first-generation antihistamines ويسبب sedation أكثر ويؤثر على الأداء المدرسي.
questions.clinicalPearl: Second-generation nonsedating antihistamines are preferred to first-generation agents for allergic rhinitis.

tts.text: A child has seasonal allergic rhinitis. Which oral antihistamine option is preferred for ongoing symptom control? Option A, loratadine. Option B, diphenhydramine. Option C, cetirizine.

questions.stemEn: A child with classic allergic facies and persistent nasal symptoms is shown in an image. What is the most effective maintenance monotherapy?
questions.explanationAr: في persistent allergic rhinitis، intranasal corticosteroid هو الأكثر فعالية كـsingle maintenance therapy، خصوصًا للاحتقان والـrhinorrhea والعطاس والحكة الأنفية.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Oral antihistamine مفيد لكنه أقل فعالية للاحتقان. Immunotherapy له دور في حالات مختارة بعد تقييم allergy specialist وليس كأول single maintenance therapy هنا.
questions.clinicalPearl: Intranasal corticosteroids are the most effective single maintenance therapy for persistent allergic rhinitis.
managementSteps: Start intranasal corticosteroid with correct spray technique

questions.stemEn: A 3-month-old infant has a dry, scaly, erythematous rash on the cheeks consistent with atopic dermatitis. Which associated physical sign is most likely?
questions.explanationAr: Atopic dermatitis في الرضع يظهر غالبًا على cheeks وextensor surfaces. Dennie-Morgan folds ترتبط بالـatopy ويمكن رؤيتها تحت الجفن السفلي.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Auspitz sign يرتبط بالـpsoriasis. Nikolsky sign يُرى في أمراض blistering مثل SSSS. Pastia lines ترتبط بالـscarlet fever.
questions.clinicalPearl: Dennie-Morgan folds are a classic atopic finding.

questions.stemEn: An 8-year-old has recurrent nasal itching triggered by dust mites. Allergy testing is positive to dust mites. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: Dust mites من perennial indoor allergens، لذلك أعراض nasal itching المتكررة معها تناسب perennial allergic rhinitis أكثر من seasonal rhinitis.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Seasonal allergic rhinitis ترتبط أكثر بالـpollens الموسمية. Sinusitis غالبًا يصاحبه facial pain أو purulent/discolored discharge وليس isolated itchiness.
questions.clinicalPearl: Dust mite exposure is a classic perennial allergic rhinitis trigger.

questions.stemEn: A 5-year-old girl has typical atopic dermatitis that remains poorly controlled despite prescribed creams and emollients. There are no signs of infection. What is the most likely reason for poor response?
questions.explanationAr: في eczema غير المستجيب مع diagnosis واضح ولا توجد infection signs، من أهم الأسباب insufficient use أو poor adherence للعلاج الموضعي. كثير من حالات 'refractory eczema' تكون بسبب عدم استخدام العلاج بالكمية أو المدة المطلوبة.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Food allergy قد تترافق لكنها ليست التفسير الأكثر شيوعًا هنا دون clues. Superinfection غير مدعومة بالفحص. Wrong diagnosis أقل احتمالًا مع typical eczema.
questions.clinicalPearl: Before escalating eczema therapy, confirm adherence and correct topical-treatment technique.
managementSteps: Review emollient and topical steroid technique

What is the most likely reason for poor response? Option A, associated food allergy. Option B, medication non-compliance. Option C, superimposed infection. Option D, wrong diagnosis.

questions.stemEn: A patient has severe atopic dermatitis with poor response to topical and systemic steroids. Which next treatment is most appropriate among the listed options?
questions.explanationAr: Topical calcineurin inhibitors مثل tacrolimus تُستخدم كsecond-line steroid-sparing therapy في حالات مختارة من moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis. لكن العمر، موضع التطبيق، ودرجة المرض مهمة جدًا؛ لذلك يحتاج السؤال تحققًا قبل النشر النهائي.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: إطالة systemic steroids ليست strategy مزمنة مفضلة بسبب adverse effects. Antibiotics لا تُستخدم دون evidence of bacterial superinfection.
questions.clinicalPearl: Topical calcineurin inhibitors are steroid-sparing options in selected patients with atopic dermatitis.

questions.stemEn: A 6-year-old develops intensely pruritic linear vesicular streaks on exposed skin after playing outdoors. She is otherwise well. Which treatment is most appropriate?

options.text: Keep lesions covered to prevent spread
Oral steroids because two sites are involved

questions.explanationAr: Linear vesicles بعد outdoor plant exposure تناسب rhus allergic contact dermatitis، وهو Type IV T-cell mediated reaction. العلاج الموضعي بـmedium-to-high potency corticosteroid مع symptomatic itch control هو الأنسب في الحالة المحدودة.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: الطفح ليس معديًا، لذلك تغطيته لا تمنع 'spread' للآخرين. Acyclovir غير مناسب لأنه ليس herpes. Systemic steroids تُحجز للحالات الواسعة أو الشديدة حسب التوزيع والموقع.
questions.clinicalPearl: Linear pruritic vesicles after plant exposure are classic for allergic contact dermatitis.

tts.text: A six-year-old develops intensely pruritic linear vesicular streaks on exposed skin after playing outdoors. She is otherwise well. Which treatment is most appropriate? Option A, keep lesions covered to prevent spread. Option B, oral steroids because two sites are involved. Option C, avoid swimming until crusted. Option D, topical corticosteroids. Option E, oral acyclovir.

questions.stemEn: A patient presents with a pruritic truncal rash. The recall is incomplete. Which listed option was chosen for symptomatic treatment?
